page.layout: One printed page. Running head and page number at the top. Main text in one column of verse with headings "E GRÆCO." and "IN HOMINEM VANUM." set centred. Marginal marks at the left and right edges are ornaments or show-through and are not transcribed as notes. Signature "K iij" at the foot.

main_text.l: Qualis Caftaly præses Apollo chori.
Sermo erat atherii de maiestate tonantis,
Vt tulerit noftra conditionis onus:
Vt neque concretam diuina potentia labem
Hauserit in fragili corpore tecta hominis:
Nec licet in serui dominus descenderit artus
Naturam exuerint membra caduca suam.
Quisquis adest dubitat scholáne immigrarit in aulâ
An magis in mediam venerit aula scholam.
Iuppiter Æthiopum conuiuia solus habeto,
Dum mihi concedas præsulis ore frui.
main_text.head: E GRÆCO.
main_text.p: LIber eram, vacuo mihi cum sub corde Neæra Ex oculis fixit spicula missa suis.
main_text.l: Deinde vnum euellens ex auricomante capillum
Vertice captiuis vincla dedit manibus.
Risi equidem, fateor, vani ludibria nexus,
Hoc laqueo facilem dum mihi spero fugam:
Aft vbi tentanti spes irrita cessit, aenis
Non secus ac manicis implicitus, gemui.
Et modo membra pilo vinctus miser abstrahor vnæ:
Quo dominæ nutus me violentus agit.
main_text.head: E GRÆCO.
main_text.p: RObora si lingua Demosthenis aqua fuissent, Nō Macedū Graias Mars populasset opes.
main_text.head: IN HOMINEM VANUM.
main_text.p: DVm blitea insani compilas scripta Doleti, Et blateras nullo iurgia tincta sale, Quicquid agunt aliy prae te contemnis, & vni
main_text.l: K iij

page.notes: Verse lines are set in italic and roman mixed type; the Greek-letter names (Æthiopum, Demosthenis) are Latin here. The initial letters L and R and D are large woodcut-style initials; read as L, R, D. Some words in the Neæra and Doleti lines are uncertain due to show-through and faint ink.
